description: CFTC Commitments of Traders positioning — Weekly CFTC Commitments of Traders for one futures market: large-speculator, commercial-hedger and small-trader net positions, week-over-week changes, % of open interest, a 0-100 COT index vs the last 3 years (EXTREME_LONG..EXTREME_SHORT), plus managed-money (disaggregated) or asset-manager/leveraged-fund (financial) nets when published, and up to 52 weeks of history. market = a common name (gold, silver, copper, crude, brent, natgas, sp500, nasdaq, dow, russell, vix, euro, yen, pound, dxy, bitcoin, ether, 2y, 10y, bond, sofr, corn, soybeans, wheat, sugar, coffee, cocoa, cotton, cattle, hogs), part of the official market name, or a 6-character CFTC contract code. Optional weeks=1-52 (default 12). U.S. government public-domain data. Price: $0.004 USDC (Base, via x402).
name: finance_cot
